lead: A fixture writing `Core\X::member(...)` for a member with an options bag panics in lowering rather than failing to check.
body: The thunk a method reference synthesizes asks each parameter for one erased type, and a `Core` options bag has none — it is flattened a slot at a time at an ordinary call and never at a thunk. Use a member with no options bag for a callable-reference fixture, or assert through an ordinary call; the panic is in `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/mod.rs`.
